nativeAdaptation.runtime: Rust generates one static HTML state per frame and drives a declared WebDriver and Chromium executable; no Node, Bun, Playwright, or committed application JavaScript is required.
nativeAdaptation.stage: The original 1920x1080 CSS, terminal chrome, caption/card geometry, quartic easing, raw trusted markup, decoded keyframes, and bottom-left background sampling are preserved in a marker-validated static template.
nativeAdaptation.protocol: The native client creates one browser session, navigates file URLs, captures base64 PNG screenshots, closes the session, and always terminates its owned driver process.
nativeAdaptation.coverage: Rust tests execute missing-frame preflight ordering, helper precedence, font discovery, stage rendering, PNG sampling, frame orchestration, progress cadence, ffconcat output, capabilities, literal loopback HTTP, chunked decoding, and WebDriver errors.
